_comment: Where the films live and which cut is current. The app reads ONLY src and rev from here; titles and everything else stay in the app, so a wrong entry can misdirect a video file but can never rewrite what the app says. A relative src resolves against FILM_HOST; an absolute https:// src is used as-is, which is how the films move to their own host without an app release. Bump rev whenever a file is re-exported under the same name, or caches keep serving the old cut.
